title: Spectacular Savoy Fire Causes $20,000 Loss
text: SPECTACULAR SAVOY FIRE CAUSES $20,000 LOSS— Shown here are the devastating effects of an early morning fire which ripped through three Savoy buildings Saturday, totally demolishing all three frame structures. First discovered at 4:30 a. m., the fire was seen in the rear of a building which formerly was used as a garage. Within a half hour flames had enveloped two other buildings to the west—Large Bros. Grocery and Savoy Masonic Lodge. Within an hour, all three buildings were leveled by the fire. (Top photo by Bob Campbell, Bells route 2; bottom, staff photo by Ray Atteberry.)
